reviews.x: It’s obviously on the cheaper end of the spectrum when it comes to an electric shaver but it works just as well as a one that costs hundreds of dollars. One of the best deals and purchases I’ve ever made on Amazon. A trimmer shouldn’t be something you have to go broke over.

I bought this razor for my dad for Father’s Day and he loved it!! He kept bragging about the close shave and how easy it was to use. I plan on purchasing another one for my husband in the near future!
For the price it's a good shaver it doesn't pull at the hair or irritate the skin, I'd buy it again.

This is a light weight and pretty great starter shaver for someone.  I do like that is arrives with a charge so you can use it right out of the box.  You get a charging cable but is is rather short and you do NOT get a wall plug so you will need your own connector.  The side open trimmer is easy to open and use as well.  My largest issue is the noise level of this shaver.  It's about double the volume of other brands I have used.  Additionally, I don't know if this would hold up if dropped in wa

reviews.t: Shaves great without pinching or pulling
reviews.x: What I liked: -The razor is so quiet I thought the batteries were almost dead -It shaves great/close without pinching -The batteries seem to last a long time. When the razor started slowing down, I charged them (red light never came on telling me to charge them) but the charge worked fine -I've been using the razor daily for weeks and I would most definitely purchase another one at this price What surprised me: -The razor is small and the shaving area is smaller than my other razors but it cuts

reviews.t: Beard and mustache trimmer totally useless
reviews.x: The basic three-head razor function is not bad, but the beard and mustache trimmer does not cut at all: the effect is like hacking away at one's face with a butter knife, occasionally grabbing a strand of hair sufficiently to pull it out by the root but otherwise having no useful effect at all.  I regret that I did not return during the window, but I bought it for travel and did not realize soon enough how bad it was.

reviews.t: The shaver  is cheaply priced but is quite good.
reviews.x: I find the shaver to be very smooth shaving. I shave in a circular direction. No scrapes or irritation. It  takes more time to shave than  expensive  shavers but leaves a lot more money in your pockets.  Another thing , the beard trimmer is large compared to other shavers and  the USB cord is a generous 35 inches long. I would rated it at 3 and 1/2  stars for actual use.  I find it an excellent buy for the 15 dollars

reviews.t: Budget shaver, for sure, but a good value
reviews.x: This shaver is for those of us with wannabe beards. If you have a steel wool type beard, don't bother with this one. It won't last you very long. But I think it works well for either younger men just starting to shave and beards like mine. I don't think you can beat it for under 20$. Great value.

reviews.t: More than expected for the money!
reviews.x: For the money you can’t beat it! It doesn’t take my beer down to super smooth but it does a nice job and it doesn’t hurt and it’s reliable. Forvthe money I don’t think you can beat it
Love this razor. It's just as good as the expensive ones. I have had this for over a month now and no problems at all. My son liked it too. I will definitely buy a few more as gifts
Purchased this electric shaver for my mentally challenged relative. He is able to self groom easier. Product is lightweight and easy to charge.

I was really hoping I snagged a good one but this one is off the mark a bit. The blades tend to snag a little bit when cutting the hairs so it pulls a little when it cuts. I also found that it doesn't contour to the face all that well even though it has the ability to flex the blades. It also just comes with a USB cord and no plug so you have to hunt around for a plug to use. reviews.t: Good emergency backup saver - no close shave
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:f269f4bbb908ea03a9ffb408f24f4cd3]] This Sunsonic electric shaver for men is simple to use. It comes fully charged. To recharge it, you simply plug the cord into a usb charger and into the shaver. It does not provide a very close shave though. If you prefer a close shave, this may not be the best option for you.  If you are looking for an inexpensive electric shaver to keep in your car or in your office for emergencies, or if you are looking for one to travel with, this is a good option

The shaver head is not removable. Description on Amazon website is incorrect. There is a picture showing "Removable Head". I tried and found no way to remove shaver head, which is connected to the body through a hinge.  It's not water-proof. I was surprised as all my shavers are water-proof. That adds difficulty to cleaning because the head cannot be removed and washed.  Edited: upgrade it from 3-star to 4-star. It's a good shaver for the price.  As a basic shaver, it works as expected. All things considered, I'm fully confident that you'll be happy with your purchase if you just want a quick, affordable shave，Very good product. 1 charge and its lasted over a month without another charge. The shaver works great. Gives a nice close shave and does not irritate the skin at all.  The trimmer on the other hand, does not work at all.  My husband tried it on his sideburns and it basically pulled the hair and nipped at the skin.  The hair was not trimmed at all.  The devices feels solid and is comfortable to hold.  If your primary reason for getting it is to shave, you'll be happy with it. If you're looking for a trimmer, might want to look elsewhere.

This razor is obviously a more cost-effective razor. First of all, when you hold it in your hand, you will feel that its lines are very comfortable and light. Secondly, when you use it to shave, there is no tingling feeling and the blade is also very sharp. It is easy to shave a long beard. If you need a product like this I will recommend it to you.

But when I do this thing is very effective and gets the job done. The trimmer is ok at cutting sideburns and probably for simple beard trimming. I can get many shaves on a single charge as I only use it in 1-2 minute session. Overall, I am happy with my purchase and this should last a long time, as long as I don't drop it like the last one.

reviews.t: Head attachment hinge breaks too easily
reviews.x: This is the second Sunsonic razor I have bought and both had the exact same problem.  In a short period of time, three months, the plastic molding that secures the spring hinge onto the shaving head has broken.  Otherwise I love the shaver but if you can't use it after a few months, because of a design flaw, it's a waste of money

I don't like to use a razor daily so this shaver is a good interim solution.  It can give you a clean reasonably close shave without having to break out the shaving cream and water.  The quality of this shaver is very cheap and it feels inferior being so light and materials of not superior quality.

An inexpensive shaver that actually gives a decent shave.  Motor speed seems a little slow.  Pop up trimmer just OK.  If shaver had head replacements available it would save the environment a bit.  But all in all a useable cheap shaver which is pretty rare.

A very satisfying shopping experience. CHEAP, super easy to use, full of power, shaved very clean, completely fit the face, shaved very clean and no noise, easy to use, the effect is very good, worth buying

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the shaver as excellent value for a low price, often comparing it favorably to much more expensive models.
Many users report a close, comfortable shave without pulling, pinching, or skin irritation.
Several reviewers find it easy to use, lightweight, and convenient to charge, including as a gift for others.
A recurring complaint is that the beard/mustache trimmer is ineffective or useless.
Some reviewers note drawbacks such as a less close shave, blade snagging, or a non-removable and non-waterproof head.
